CheckTitle: CloudTrail log groups found with secrets in CloudWatch logs
Description: Secrets from CloudTrail log groups found in CloudWatch logs.
Risk: Storing sensitive information in CloudWatch logs can prove to be dangerous, as anyone with read-only access would be able to access and use the information to gain unauthorized access.

Recommendation.Text: Sensitive data should not be added in logs, and if necessary, they must be masked using a protection policy.
